summary:
Opened the Neon Runner demo project, switched the agent panel to Build mode, and sent the requested instruction: “Move the player object down by 40 units.”
The change was applied successfully. The editor showed 1 undo entry and 0 redo entries.
After Undo was pressed once, the editor showed 0 undo entries and 1 redo entry.
After Redo was pressed once, the editor returned to 1 undo entry and 0 redo entries.
oneLiner: moved the player object down by 40 units on the Neon Runner demo project
